description.description: Detailed description of the widget's capabilities and purpose

widget_type.description: Categorizes the widget as service (active, streaming) or unlock (passive feature access)

widget_class.description: Explicit classification for UI sorting and system routing

nft_id.description: Unique identifier of the underlying NFT on the XRPL

version.description: Current version of the widget metadata (semver)

metadata_version.description: Version of the Widget Metadata Standard this record conforms to

metadata_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical metadata JSON at time of minting

minted_by.description: Agent ID or entity that minted this widget

is_active.description: Current activation status of the widget in a user's dashboard

cost_per_stream_interval.description: Cost in RLUSD for each micro-streaming interval

required_agent_role.description: Minimum agent role required to activate this widget

dependencies.description: List of other Widget NFT IDs this widget depends on

deprecation_status.description: Status indicating if the widget is nearing deprecation or disabled by governance

governance_notes.description: Relevant governance decisions or alerts concerning this widget

creator_id.description: Agent ID or entity that created the widget's underlying service/feature

image_url.description: URL to a visual representation or icon for the widget

ui_behavior.description: Defines how the widget behaves in the dashboard UI

feature_path.description: Internal path or identifier to the feature unlocked by this widget

royalties_config.description: Revenue split for streaming service charges

allowed_agent_permissions.description: Specific permissions an agent gains when this widget is active

chrome_skill_instructions.description: Chrome Gemini Side Panel skill definitions

mint_status.description: Lifecycle status of the XRPL minting process

xrpl_mint_payload.description: Prepared NFTokenMint transaction payload for XRPL

xrpl_tx_hash.description: XRPL transaction hash once minted on mainnet
